note: Prompts for the hour of peer discussion at each monthly FET meeting. Groups choose freely — nothing here is assigned to a particular month.
noteZh: 外師會議每月一小時同儕討論用的提綱。各組自由挑選，沒有指定哪個月討論哪一塊。

topics.en: The same class is calm for your co-teacher and chaotic for you. What is actually different?
topics.zh: 同一個班，協同老師帶得很順，你帶就亂。差別到底在哪？

topics.en: Stickers, points, prizes — where is the line between motivating and bribing? What have you stopped doing?
topics.zh: 貼紙、點數、獎品——激勵和賄賂的界線在哪？你停掉了什麼作法？

topics.en: A student who never speaks. Three things you have tried, and which one moved the needle.
topics.zh: 從來不開口的學生。你試過哪三種方法？哪一種真的有用？

topics.en: How much noise is too much? How do you signal it without raising your voice?
topics.zh: 多吵算太吵？你怎麼在不吼的情況下讓他們知道？

topics.en: The activity finishes early and there are five minutes left. What do you actually do?
topics.zh: 活動提早結束、還剩五分鐘。你實際上都做什麼？

topics.en: Discipline is the homeroom teacher's job — agree or disagree? What happens when they leave the room?
topics.zh: 管秩序是導師的事——你同意嗎？導師走出教室之後呢？

topics.en: A class you dread. If you could change one thing about it, what would it be?
topics.zh: 有一個班你每次去都很怕。如果只能改一件事，你改什麼？

topics.en: Getting 30 students quiet in under ten seconds. What works in your room?
topics.zh: 十秒內讓 30 個學生安靜。你的教室裡什麼方法有效？

topics.en: Seating — do you move students? Who decides? What happened when you tried?
topics.zh: 座位——你會調嗎？誰決定？你調過之後發生什麼事？

topics.en: The student who finishes everything in two minutes. What do you give them?
topics.zh: 兩分鐘就把所有東西做完的學生。你給他什麼？

topics.en: Instructions in English that nobody follows. Where exactly does it break down?
topics.zh: 用英文說明但沒人照做。到底是哪一步斷掉的？

topics.en: Phones, water bottles, heads on desks. Which battles do you actually fight?
topics.zh: 手機、水壺、趴著睡。哪些你真的會管？

topics.en: A rule you introduced that failed. Why do you think it failed?
topics.zh: 你訂過但失敗的規矩。你覺得為什麼失敗？

topics.en: What you do in the first two minutes of every single lesson.
topics.zh: 每一堂課的前兩分鐘，你固定做什麼？

topics.en: The class right after PE, or right before lunch. Do you teach it differently?
topics.zh: 體育課後、午餐前的那一堂。你會教得不一樣嗎？

topics.en: A student who is disruptive because the work is too hard. How do you tell the difference?
topics.zh: 因為聽不懂而搗蛋的學生。你怎麼分辨是不會還是不想？

topics.en: Praise — public or private, English or Chinese, what and how often?
topics.zh: 稱讚——公開還是私下？英文還是中文？稱讚什麼、多常？

topics.en: What does your class do while you are writing on the board with your back turned?
topics.zh: 你轉身寫黑板的時候，班上在做什麼？

topics.en: A behaviour you tolerated for months and then changed your mind about.
topics.zh: 有個行為你忍了好幾個月，後來改變主意開始管。是什麼？

topics.en: If a new FET took over your class tomorrow, what one warning would you give them?
topics.zh: 如果明天換一位新外師接你的班，你會先警告他哪一件事？

topics.en: An activity that worked brilliantly in one class and died in another. Why?
topics.zh: 同一個活動，在一個班超成功、在另一個班全死。為什麼？

topics.en: How long is too long? Your rule of thumb by grade level.
topics.zh: 一個活動多長算太長？你各年級的判斷標準是什麼？

topics.en: Your best activity that needs zero preparation and zero materials.
topics.zh: 完全不用準備、不用教具的活動，你最好的一個是什麼？

topics.en: Group work with fixed seating and 30 students. What actually works?
topics.zh: 座位固定、30 個學生的分組活動。什麼真的行得通？

topics.en: Take a textbook unit you find boring and walk us through how you changed it.
topics.zh: 挑一個你覺得無聊的課本單元，講你怎麼改的。

topics.en: Mixed ability — the strong students bored, the weak ones lost. Your fix.
topics.zh: 程度落差：強的無聊、弱的跟不上。你的解法。

topics.en: The activity you keep going back to. Why does it keep working?
topics.zh: 你一用再用的那個活動。它為什麼一直有效？

topics.en: Making an activity produce real language instead of just noise.
topics.zh: 怎麼讓活動真的產出語言，而不是只有熱鬧？

topics.en: An activity that took three attempts to get right. What changed each time?
topics.zh: 改了三次才成功的活動。每一次改了什麼？

topics.en: Activities where every student speaks, not just the confident ones.
topics.zh: 能讓每個學生都開口、不只是敢講的那幾個。

topics.en: Adapting an activity you found online for a Taiwanese classroom. What had to change?
topics.zh: 把網路上找到的活動改到台灣教室。哪些非改不可？

topics.en: The activity is going badly halfway through. Do you stop or push on?
topics.zh: 活動做到一半發現不行。你喊停還是硬做完？

topics.en: Activities that use the classroom space, not just the desks.
topics.zh: 用到整間教室、不只是趴在桌上的活動。

topics.en: Writing activities that students do not hate.
topics.zh: 學生不會排斥的寫作活動。

topics.en: Listening activities beyond "listen and circle the answer".
topics.zh: 除了「聽完圈答案」以外的聽力活動。

topics.en: An activity your co-teacher suggested that you would never have thought of.
topics.zh: 協同老師提出、你自己絕對想不到的活動。

topics.en: Preparing one lesson you have to teach six times to six classes.
topics.zh: 同一堂課要教六個班六次。你怎麼準備？

topics.en: Activities for the week before 段考, when nobody can concentrate.
topics.zh: 段考前一週，沒人專心得了。這時候做什麼活動？

topics.en: How do you know an activity worked? What do you look for?
topics.zh: 你怎麼判斷一個活動成功了？你看的是什麼？

topics.en: The activity you have quietly retired. Why?
topics.zh: 你已經默默不用的活動。為什麼不用了？

topics.en: A game that teaches versus a game that just entertains. One example of each from your own class.
topics.zh: 「有教到東西的遊戲」和「只是熱鬧的遊戲」。各舉一個你班上的例子。

topics.en: Team games and the student who gets blamed for losing. How do you handle it?
topics.zh: 分組競賽輸了，那組開始怪某個同學。你怎麼處理？

topics.en: Games that work in fixed rows with 30 students.
topics.zh: 座位排排坐、30 個人也能玩的遊戲。

topics.en: A game gets too competitive. What is your reset?
topics.zh: 遊戲玩到火氣上來。你怎麼把它拉回來？

topics.en: Digital or paper — what have you found actually works better, and for what?
topics.zh: 電子的還是紙本的？你實際發現哪種好用、用在什麼地方？

topics.en: A game you have adapted three times. What changed each time?
topics.zh: 你改過三次的遊戲。每次改了什麼？

topics.en: Games with no materials, no preparation, five minutes.
topics.zh: 不用教具、不用準備、五分鐘的遊戲。

topics.en: How do you know a game worked?
topics.zh: 你怎麼知道一個遊戲成功了？

topics.en: Games where the quiet students are not invisible.
topics.zh: 不會讓安靜的學生變透明的遊戲。

topics.en: Scoring — individual, team, or none at all? What did you learn?
topics.zh: 計分——個人、小組、還是根本不計分？你的心得。

topics.en: A game that got out of control. What would you do differently?
topics.zh: 有一次遊戲整個失控。重來一次你會怎麼做？

topics.en: Games for six-year-olds versus games for twelve-year-olds. What changes?
topics.zh: 六歲和十二歲玩的遊戲差在哪？

topics.en: The prize question — do you give any? What happened when you stopped?
topics.zh: 獎品這件事——你給嗎？停掉之後發生什麼？

topics.en: Games that review without feeling like review.
topics.zh: 在複習但學生不覺得在複習的遊戲。

topics.en: A game your students ask for by name. Why that one?
topics.zh: 學生會指名要玩的遊戲。為什麼是那一個？

topics.en: Turning a game into something they can play again without you.
topics.zh: 把遊戲變成他們沒有你也能自己玩的東西。

topics.en: Games that fit the last five minutes and are not just filler.
topics.zh: 剛好塞得進最後五分鐘、又不只是打發時間的遊戲。

topics.en: Boys versus girls teams — do you do it? What are the problems?
topics.zh: 男生對女生分隊——你會這樣分嗎？有什麼問題？

topics.en: A classic game everyone uses that you think is overrated. Defend your position.
topics.zh: 大家都在用、但你覺得被高估的經典遊戲。說服我們。

topics.en: Explaining a game in English to students who do not have the words yet.
topics.zh: 學生還沒學到那些字，你怎麼用英文把遊戲規則講清楚？

topics.en: What does "on time" actually mean at your school? How did you find out?
topics.zh: 你學校的「準時」實際上是幾點？你怎麼發現的？

topics.en: You are asked to do something outside your contract. How do you decide?
topics.zh: 被要求做合約以外的事。你怎麼決定接不接？

topics.en: Dress, phone use, eating at your desk. What did you get wrong at first?
topics.zh: 穿著、用手機、在座位吃東西。你一開始弄錯了什麼？

topics.en: Taking leave — what is the unwritten protocol at your school?
topics.zh: 請假——你學校沒有寫出來的規矩是什麼？

topics.en: You disagree with a school decision. Where and how do you say so?
topics.zh: 你不認同學校的決定。你在哪裡、用什麼方式說？

topics.en: Being asked to appear in photos, videos, promotional material. Where is your line?
topics.zh: 被要求入鏡拍照、錄影、做宣傳。你的界線在哪？

topics.en: What does your school expect of you that is not in the contract?
topics.zh: 學校對你的期待中，有哪些是合約裡沒寫的？

topics.en: Preparing versus improvising. How much preparation is enough?
topics.zh: 備課與臨場發揮。準備到什麼程度算夠？

topics.en: Arriving early and leaving on time versus staying late. What gets noticed?
topics.zh: 早到準時走，還是留下來加班？學校實際上看的是什麼？

topics.en: Being asked to help with something unrelated to English. Do you?
topics.zh: 被找去幫跟英文無關的忙。你幫嗎？

topics.en: Someone covers your class. What do you owe them?
topics.zh: 有人幫你代課。你欠他什麼？

topics.en: You made a mistake that affected a class. What did you do?
topics.zh: 你犯了一個影響到整班的錯。你怎麼處理的？

topics.en: Paperwork deadlines you do not understand. How do you handle them?
topics.zh: 看不懂的文件和期限。你怎麼應付？

topics.en: Weekend and evening events. Expected or optional?
topics.zh: 週末和晚上的活動。是義務還是自願？

topics.en: Social media and your students. What are your rules?
topics.zh: 社群媒體與學生。你的規則是什麼？

topics.en: Being praised publicly for something you do not think you did well.
topics.zh: 因為一件你自認沒做好的事被公開表揚。

topics.en: What do you do when you have no class and no task?
topics.zh: 沒課也沒事的時間，你都在做什麼？

topics.en: Turning down extra work without being seen as difficult.
topics.zh: 推掉額外工作，又不會被覺得難搞。

topics.en: Something you do now that you would not have done in your first month.
topics.zh: 你現在會做、但第一個月絕對不會做的事。

topics.en: What would make you decide not to renew? Have you told anyone?
topics.zh: 什麼情況會讓你決定不續約？你跟誰說過嗎？

topics.en: Your first week versus now — what do you understand about the staffroom that you did not?
topics.zh: 第一週和現在——你現在懂了什麼當時不懂的辦公室文化？

topics.en: A colleague who never speaks to you. Have you tried? What happened?
topics.zh: 從來不跟你說話的同事。你主動過嗎？結果如何？

topics.en: Gifts, invitations, shared food. What is expected and what is optional?
topics.zh: 送禮、邀約、分食物。哪些是該做的、哪些是隨意？

topics.en: Talking to parents when you share no language.
topics.zh: 跟語言不通的家長溝通。

topics.en: Saying no without damaging the relationship.
topics.zh: 怎麼拒絕又不傷關係。

topics.en: Being the only foreigner in the building. What do you do about it?
topics.zh: 整棟樓只有你一個外國人。你怎麼面對？

topics.en: A misunderstanding you had, and how it got resolved.
topics.zh: 你遇過的一次誤會，後來怎麼化解的。

topics.en: Who do you go to when something goes wrong? How did you find that person?
topics.zh: 出事的時候你找誰？你是怎麼找到這個人的？

topics.en: Co-teaching — who plans, who leads? How did you two settle it, or have you?
topics.zh: 協同教學——誰備課、誰主導？你們談過嗎，還是一直沒講清楚？

topics.en: Your co-teacher translates everything you say. Good or bad? What have you tried?
topics.zh: 協同老師把你說的每一句都翻成中文。好事還是壞事？你試過什麼？

topics.en: Disagreeing with your co-teacher about a student, in front of the students.
topics.zh: 當著學生的面，你和協同老師對某個學生的處理方式不同調。

topics.en: The co-teacher who does nothing in your lesson — and the one who takes over.
topics.zh: 在你的課上什麼都不做的協同老師，以及整堂搶走的那一種。

topics.en: What does your co-teacher wish you did differently? Have you ever asked?
topics.zh: 協同老師希望你哪裡做得不一樣？你問過她嗎？

topics.en: Changing co-teachers mid-year. How do you restart?
topics.zh: 學年中途換協同老師。你怎麼重新開始？

topics.en: The best ten minutes of co-teaching you have had. What made it work?
topics.zh: 你經歷過最好的十分鐘協同教學。它為什麼成功？

topics.en: Being invited to something you do not want to attend.
topics.zh: 被邀去一個你其實不想去的場合。

topics.en: Office small talk when your Chinese is limited. What do you actually say?
topics.zh: 中文有限的情況下的辦公室閒聊。你實際上都說什麼？

topics.en: A favour someone did for you that you did not ask for. How did you respond?
topics.zh: 有人幫了你一個你沒開口要的忙。你怎麼回應？

topics.en: When a student tells you something about their home life.
topics.zh: 學生跟你說了家裡的事。

topics.en: The relationship at school that has made the biggest difference to your year.
topics.zh: 學校裡哪一段關係，對你這一年影響最大？
